title: Indicators of compromise (IoC) and of attack (IoA)

videos.script: An address is evidence that something happened. It is weak evidence that it will happen again. {{weak}} Change one byte of a file and its hash is new. Rent another server and the address is new. Those are indicators of compromise, and they are cheap for the other side to change. {{ioc}} What is expensive to change is the way somebody works. Many accounts, then one success. A login by a method the account never used. A first transfer to a destination nobody has ever sent to. {{ioa}} Those are indicators of attack, and they survive a new address. At the end you put a name on each step of Thursday, from a shared catalogue called ATT&CK. {{attack}}
